title: In-silico screening of bioactive compounds of Moringa oleifera as potential inhibitors targeting HIF-1alpha/VEGF/GLUT-1 pathway against breast cancer.
authors: Masarkar, Neha; Pal, Maynak; Roy, Mithun; Yadav, Ashish K; Pandya, Bharati; Lokhande, Suryabhan; Kanwar, Jagat R; Ray, Suman Kumar; Mukherjee, Sukhes
one_liner_zh: 该研究用AutoDock Vina对辣木活性化合物与HIF-1alpha/VEGF/GLUT-1蛋白进行分子对接筛选，虽涉及蛋白-小分子互作，但对象非蛋白质-DNA体系，且无TF-DNA结合或AI/物理模拟方法创新，仅常规对接与ADME分析，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: Breast cancer is among the most heterogeneous and aggressive diseases and a foremost cause of death in women globally. Hypoxic activation of HIF-1alpha in breast cancers triggers the transcription of a battery of genes encoding proteins that facilitate tumor growth and metastasis and is correlated with a poor prognosis. Based on the reported cytotoxic and anti-cancer properties of Moringa oleifera (Mo), this study explores the inhibitory effect of bioactive compounds from M. oleifera and breast cancer target proteins HIF-1alpha, VEGF, and GLUT-1 in silico. METHODS: The X-ray crystallographic structures of HIF-1alpha, VEGF, and GLUT1 were sourced from the Protein Data Bank (PDB) and docked with 70 3D PubChem structures of bioactive compounds of M. oleifera using AutoDock Vina, and binding modes were analyzed using Discovery Studio. Five compounds with the highest binding energies were selected and further drug-likeness, oral bioavailability, ADME, and toxicity profiles were analyzed using SwissADME, ADMETSaR, and ADMETlab 3.0 web server. RESULTS: Out of the screened 70 bioactive compounds, the top five compounds with the best binding energies were identified namely Apigenin, Ellagic Acid, Isorhamnetin, Luteolin, and Myricetin with each receptor. Molecular docking results indicated that the ligands interact strongly with the target HIF-1alpha, VEGF, and GLUT-1 receptors through hydrogen bonds and hydrophobic interactions. These compounds showed favorable drug-like and pharmacokinetic properties, possessed no substantial toxicity, and were fairly bioavailable. CONCLUSIONS: Results suggested that the compounds possess strong potential in developing putative lead compounds targeting HIF-1alpha that are safe natural plant-based drugs against breast cancer.
abstract_zh: 目的：乳腺癌是最具异质性和侵袭性的疾病之一，也是全球女性死亡的主要原因。乳腺癌中HIF-1alpha的缺氧激活触发了一系列编码促进肿瘤生长和转移的蛋白质的基因转录，并与不良预后相关。基于辣木（Moringa oleifera, Mo）已报道的细胞毒性和抗癌特性，本研究在计算机模拟中探讨了辣木生物活性化合物对乳腺癌靶蛋白HIF-1alpha、VEGF和GLUT-1的抑制作用。方法：从蛋白质数据银行（Protein Data Bank, PDB）获取HIF-1alpha、VEGF和GLUT1的X射线晶体结构，并使用AutoDock Vina与辣木70种3D PubChem生物活性化合物结构进行对接，结合模式通过Discovery Studio分析。选择结合能最高的五种化合物，进一步使用SwissADME、ADMETSaR和ADMETlab 3.0网络服务器分析其药物相似性、口服生物利用度、ADME和毒性特征。结果：在筛选的70种生物活性化合物中，确定了与每个受体结合能最佳的前五种化合物，即芹菜素（Apigenin）、鞣花酸（Ellagic Acid）、异鼠李素（Isorhamnetin）、木犀草素（Luteolin）和杨梅素（Myricetin）。分子对接结果表明，配体通过氢键和疏水相互作用与靶标HIF-1alpha、VEGF和GLUT-1受体强烈结合。这些化合物显示出良好的药物相似性和药代动力学特性，无明显毒性，且具有较好的生物利用度。结论：结果表明，这些化合物在开发针对HIF-1alpha的潜在先导化合物方面具有强大潜力，可作为对抗乳腺癌的安全天然植物基药物。
